title: Downtown Condo w/ Pool & View - Walk Everywhere!
description:
Hey Ya'll. Come Experience All that Nashville has to offer. Short 20-25 minute walk or 4 minute Uber to Broadway. This condo sits on the second floor with a wonderful river view. We have Free Parking, Free Wifi and Free FUN! Walking distance to Bicentennial Park, The Farmers Market, Sounds Stadium and more. We provide all the amenities you will need and do our very best to make sure you have a great time. Stay here and You won't be disappointed. Come visit Us!

The space
-Comfy, KING size mattress in the primary bedroom
-Twin size memory foam daybed 
-Twin size memory foam trundle bed
-All linens, sheets, and towels provided
-Full kitchen with all cookware 
-HDTV in the living room
-Free parking
-Free wifi
-Outdoor pool (open May 15th-Oct. 30th)
-Workout facility
-Laundry facility
-Conveniently close to Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena, Country Music Hall of Fame, Johnny Cash Museum, Ryman Auditorium, and much more!

Guest access
Guests have full access to the condo, pool, laundry & workout facilities, and free parking. The condo is private with a keyless entrance, and entirely yours for the duration of your stay.

Other things to note
This unit is on the second floor with one flight of steps to enter. The condo has TV's in both rooms. The condo's kitchen is stocked with many things, however we only provide coffee grounds for the drip coffee maker.  There is a Keurig-type machine, but you will need to supply your own pods. We also provide salt and pepper, cooking spray, and cooking oil.  If you would like to use more spices etc, you will need to provide your own.
